steps.title: Your day
steps.say: You have one thing on your calendar today. Cascade grade review at six in the evening. Then you're free for five hours forty minutes.

items.label: Cascade grade review, six in the evening

steps.title: Choose
steps.say: One thing needs you to choose. You're double-booked Saturday at ten in the morning. Sam's move to the new place, or the pier pickups with Lena. Which one do you want to keep?

items.label: Sam and Lena, Saturday at ten in the morning

steps.question: Which one do you want to keep?

steps.title: Needs you
steps.say: Seven things need you. Marco has waited twenty hours on going over the client's notes on the Aster edit. Priya has waited five days on the Lumen campaign. Kestrel Rentals has waited four days on the camera package rental. And four more. Should I snooze any of these until tomorrow morning?

items.label: Marco, going over the client's notes on the Aster edit
Kestrel Rentals, the camera package rental

steps.question: Should I snooze any of these until tomorrow morning?

steps.title: Coming up
steps.say: Eleven things are coming up in the next thirty days. Tomorrow, help rig the lights at seven in the evening. In three days, Jamie's birthday. In five days, Kestrel invoice due, one thousand two hundred forty dollars. And eight more.

items.label: help rig the lights at seven in the evening
Kestrel invoice due, one thousand two hundred forty dollars

steps.title: A bill and a trip
steps.say: One bill to pay and a trip coming up. Kestrel Rentals, one thousand two hundred forty dollars, due Monday, November sixteenth. Flight to Austin, Thursday, November nineteenth at nine oh five in the morning.

steps.title: Clean up
steps.say: Twelve things to clean up, mostly newsletters, Slack chatter and receipts. Clear them in the app when you have a minute.
